fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health: you clamp and roll, dealing 24 damage plus 1.6 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up, and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Clamped Jaw
fusions.desc: A steel-jawed bite that deals 13 damage, holds the target stunned for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% for 8 seconds, and you move 30% faster for the first 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Saved Grievance
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. Your next ability spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
